- **Save to Frameleaf 1.2.0 (FL-1729):** keyboard shortcuts open the extension (⌥⇧F or Alt+Shift+F), take a screenshot (⌥⇧S) and save the page as a link (⌥⇧L); change them on your browser's shortcuts page from the extension's Settings. The toolbar button shows how many items are waiting, or "!" when one needs you. Right-click a link to save it without opening it, or select text and right-click to save the page with that text as its note.
